---
title: "Fig. 2L - Pnut RNAi Vsg+ ring canal-to-cell ratio"
output: null
date: "2026-02-27"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggprism)
library(ggpubr)
source("analysis_helpers.R")
```

```{r}
# Fig. 2L: calculate Vsg+ ring canal-to-follicle-cell ratio for each germarium.

data_file <- "../Data/Fig2L_pnutRNAi_Vsg_RC_to_cell_ratio.csv"
output_file <- "../Results/Fig2L_pnutRNAi_Vsg_RC_to_cell_ratio.pdf"

pnutrnai_vsgrings_totalcells <- read_analysis_csv(data_file) %>%
  mutate(Vsg_Ring_to_Cell_Ratio = VsgRings / TotalCells)
```

```{r}
# Fig. 2L: average ratios within each replicate for statistical testing.
# Individual germaria are shown as points in the plot.

pnutrnai_vsgrings_totalcells_summary <- pnutrnai_vsgrings_totalcells %>%
  group_by(Genotype, Group, Replicate) %>%
  summarise(
    Vsg_Ring_to_Cell_Ratio = mean(Vsg_Ring_to_Cell_Ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    TotalCell_Mean = mean(TotalCells, na.rm = TRUE),
    TotalCell_SD = sd(TotalCells, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
# Fig. 2L: compare replicate means between control and pnut RNAi.

stat_results <- pnutrnai_vsgrings_totalcells_summary %>%
  rstatix::t_test(Vsg_Ring_to_Cell_Ratio ~ Group) %>%
  rstatix::add_significance("p") %>%
  rstatix::add_xy_position(x = "Group", step.increase = 0.5, dodge = 0.8)
print(stat_results)
```

```{r}
# Fig. 2L: plot Vsg+ ring canal-to-cell ratios.

plot_box_jitter(
  data = pnutrnai_vsgrings_totalcells,
  summary_data = pnutrnai_vsgrings_totalcells_summary,
  x = Group,
  y = Vsg_Ring_to_Cell_Ratio,
  plot_title = "Vsg RC to total follicle cell ratio",
  y_limits = c(0, 2),
  p_values = stat_results
)
```


```{r}
ggsave(output_file, width = 2, height = 3, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)
```

```{r}
# Fig. 2L: manuscript summary values for replicate means.

summarize_mean_sd(
  pnutrnai_vsgrings_totalcells_summary,
  group_cols = "Group",
  value_col = Vsg_Ring_to_Cell_Ratio
)
```
